description: This file contains unit tests for the EagerOperationBuilder class in the TensorFlow Java API, verifying its behavior when creating and configuring operations within an eager execution session.

classes.name: EagerOperationBuilderTest
classes.description: A unit test class testing the behavior of the EagerOperationBuilder within the TensorFlow Java API.

methods.name: failToCreateIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Tests that creating a new EagerOperationBuilder with a closed session throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: failToBuildOpIfSessionIsClosed
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to set attributes on an operation after closing the session results in an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: addInputs
methods.description: Tests adding input tensors and input lists to an operation, and verifies that control inputs cannot be added after execution.

methods.name: setDevice
methods.description: Verifies setting a device placement string for an operation.

methods.name: setAttrs
methods.description: Executes various configurations of setting attributes (dtype, shape, list attributes, etc.) on operations to ensure no exceptions are thrown.
